publication_scope: Metadata only. No original HTML, PDF, XLSX, article title, snippet, literal core/evidence text, macro value or forecast interval is included in these artifacts.
legal_scope: Current primary-source website notices checked on 2026-10-07. This is a documented conservative publication decision, not a historical license snapshot or a grant of rights for all project data.
historical_scope: Existing publication, retrieval, availability, vintage and A/B statuses are copied from saved inputs. Current terms and newly published metadata do not prove availability in 2023-2024. No original source is redownloaded or replaced.
reconstruction_limit: These metadata files do not reconstruct numeric macro features, original news text, geography mappings, consumption data, model predictions or the complete historical pipeline.
quote_limit: At most 25 quoted words in total per primary-source page URL; no news article text is quoted.

artifacts.row_unit: Saved snapshot/version, not a distinct URL-document or independent event.
artifacts.codes_note: Topic, event_type and direction are existing project heuristic codes, not independent economic-shock ground truth. Personal or territorial dictionary names are omitted.

artifacts.row_unit: Provenance of one saved forecast observation, with its numeric value withheld.
artifacts.identifier_rule: provenance_id is macro_ plus SHA256 of compact JSON with ordered string keys indicator, reference_period, target_period, published_at, available_at, vintage_id, source_url, forecast_producer, forecast_issue_date, availability_status. Numeric observations are not used in the identifier.
artifacts.source_hash_rule: Exact source_url match against the saved primary_source catalog entry. File path is normalized to project-relative form; no current web file is substituted.
artifacts.definition_note: Survey-participant forecasts and the Bank of Russia's own forecasts remain distinct. Annual forecasts are not monthly consumption observations. central_method records the existing derivation label, including range midpoint where applicable; it is not an official central forecast. A uses explicit official-archive trust, without an independently collected historical SHA; B remains current-vintage/unconfirmed and was not silently promoted.
